notes.content:

I'm balancing this with giving our main character a sprucing up. Excited to show you this in the next updated. Thanks for your support. Here's some more boss art (spoilers!). notes.title: Development Update August 2025
notes.content:
A warm August hello to everyone! The weather might still be toasty here in the UK, but development on From Fire is just as hot. Over the past few weeks, I’ve been diving deep into the final stages of the boss character. The mechanics are proving to be quite involved but I'm having fun implementing my vision. I'm also investigating the possibility of updating our main character Sgt. Aaron to give him more fidelity. Watch this space! Thanks so much for following the journey—hope you’re enjoying the rest of your summer! Oh and here's some promo boss art I put together, spoilers ahead :)

[spoiler]

notes.title: Development Update July 2025
notes.content: A big July greeting to you all! Developing in a British heatwave has its challenges but it will not deter me :). This past month, I’ve been working hard on the remaining boss character. The model and texturing is done. The animation, programming and mechanics continue. This boss plays a huge role in From Fire, and I want it to be something players remember (and maybe have nightmares about) for a long time. Have a great summer and thank you for your support.

notes.title: Development Update June 2025
notes.content: Happy June everyone! A quick update on what I've been up to. Boss fights have been the focus recently and will be the focus for the next few weeks as well. The good news is that there’s only one boss left to do and the model for it is already finished. I’m really pleased with how these battles have turned out, given how ambitious they were. The remaining boss is no different and I’ve been looking forward to working on this one for a very long time. The concept for this boss was first created in my mind ever since I played ‘Zombies Ate My Neighbors’ on the SNES. I am thrilled that I can now make that idea a reality and get it into your hands. As always thanks for all the support and motivation you give me!

notes.title: Development Update May 2025
notes.content: Hey horror fans, here’s what I’ve been up to this May. I've mostly spent time designing and implementing boss characters of the game. I'm trying to ensure the bosses have some depth to them and remain faithful to English folklore source material. They'll have their own story that you, the player, will be a part of. I really hope you enjoy fighting these guys in the battles I'm crafting for you!

notes.title: Development Update April 2025
notes.content:
Hey horror fans, here’s what I’ve been up to this April. Time had been mostly spent finishing the enemy characters that you will face in the game. I really hope you enjoy fighting (or avoiding) them! The next piece of work I've moved onto is creating boss characters.  Suffice to say huge spoilers ahead so do not reveal if you would prefer waiting to experience these enemies in-game. For the more curious out there, the next bit is for you.

notes.title: Development Update March 2025
notes.content: I'm deep in development focusing on key characters. I'm putting a lot of effort into creating these characters and given recent feedback to avoid spoilers, I won't post them here so you all get to experience them for the first time in game. Things are moving along and I want updates like this to give you an idea of the general area I'm working on and to assure you that progress is being made!
